summary: Owned-set source policies accept and enforce native objective and GitHub configuration namespaces

replay.detail: Existing policy receipts replay unchanged; upgraded readers enforce native namespace ownership using the same source-policy matcher.

rules.detail: Namespace and unmanaged-allow globs accept objective/, github-source/ and github-scope/. Namespace ownership refuses unmanaged native declarations, and explicit allow globs exempt them. Unsupported families remain rejected.

compatibility.detail: Policies naming native families require every admitted member to advertise features.owned_set_native_policy=1, even when the set has no native members. Native membership support alone did not establish native policy support.

downtime.detail: Existing legacy-family policies continue to work during upgrade.

manual.detail: Upgrade all admitted readers before enabling native namespace policies. The daemon and health response advertise owned_set_native_policy=1.

recovery.detail: Before the upgrade completes, native policy publication is blocked without changing the prior selected policy.
